skills.name: canslim-screener
skills.description_zh: 用欧奈尔 CANSLIM 方法筛选成长股与动量股。
skills.func: 用欧奈尔CANSLIM七要素为美股打分排序，输出成长股候选名单
skills.how: 帮我用CANSLIM方法筛一批盈利和价格动量都强的美股
skills.input: FMP 数据源账号（必需）；可指定股票池/板块、候选数量、RS 基准等参数
skills.output: reports/ 目录下生成 JSON 与 Markdown 报告，含市场环境与 M 分、按综合分排名的候选、每只股的 C/A/N/S/L/I/M 分项得分、评级分布（Exceptional+/Exceptional/Strong/Above Average）
skills.note: 依赖 FMP 行情接口，部分机构持股数据回退到 Finviz 网页抓取；均需联网
skills.description_en: Screen US stocks using William O'Neil's CANSLIM growth stock methodology. Use when user requests CANSLIM stock screening, growth stock analysis, momentum stock identification, or wants to find stocks with strong earnings and price momentum following O'Neil's investment system.

skills.name: dividend-growth-pullback-screener
skills.description_zh: 筛选高股息成长股中正经历暂时回调的标的。
skills.func: 筛选股息高增长但RSI超卖回调的美股，捕捉买入时机
skills.how: 帮我找股息增长快、但眼下被超卖回调的优质分红股
skills.input: FMP 数据源账号（必需）；可选 FINVIZ Elite 数据源账号；可调最低股息率、最低股息增速、RSI 上限等参数
skills.output: JSON 与 Markdown 报告，含各股股息增长画像（股息率、3 年复合增速、派息率与可持续性）、RSI 数值与超卖分区、营收/EPS 成长与财务健康指标，以及分批建仓与止损等入场建议
skills.note: 12% 股息增速门槛较严，通常仅少数股票入选；可放宽参数扩大结果
skills.description_en: Use this skill to find high-quality dividend growth stocks (12%+ annual dividend growth, 1.5%+ yield) that are experiencing temporary pullbacks, identified by RSI oversold conditions (RSI ≤40). This skill combines fundamental dividend analysis with technical timing indicators to identify buying opportunities in strong dividend growers during short-term weakness.

skills.name: finviz-screener
skills.description_zh: 把自然语言筛选条件转成 Finviz 筛选链接并打开结果。
skills.func: 把自然语言的选股条件翻译成Finviz筛选代码，构造并打开结果页
skills.how: 帮我找高股息、低估值的小盘股，条件在Finviz上给我看看
skills.input: 一句话筛选需求（基本面/技术面/板块/主题，支持中英日文）；可选视图类型与排序方式
skills.output: 构造好的 Finviz 筛选器 URL 并打开浏览器（或用 --url-only 仅打印）；执行前给出筛选条件确认表，并说明使用 Public 还是 Elite 模式
skills.note: 无需 数据源账号 也可用公共筛选器；数据源账号 仅用于自动启用 Elite
skills.description_en: Build and open FinViz screener URLs from natural language requests. Use when user wants to screen stocks, find stocks matching criteria, filter by fundamentals or technicals, or asks to open FinViz with specific conditions. Supports both Japanese and English input (e.g., "高配当で成長している小型株を探したい", "Find oversold large caps with high ROE").

skills.name: pead-screener
skills.description_zh: 筛选财报后跳空个股，识别财报漂移形态。
skills.func: 筛选财报后跳空的美股PEAD漂移形态，识别红K回调与突破
skills.how: 帮我找财报跳空上涨后、周线出现红K回调还没突破的股票
skills.input: FMP 数据源账号，或财报交易分析器输出的 JSON（schema_version 1.0）；可调回溯天数、监控周数、最小跳空幅度、最低市值
skills.output: JSON 与 Markdown 报告，含阶段分类（MONITORING/SIGNAL_READY/BREAKOUT/EXPIRED）、周线蜡烛形态、复合评分与评级、入场/止损/目标与盈亏比、流动性指标（20 日均额等）
skills.note: Mode A 会拉取全球财报日历，做美股票单时建议用 Mode B 输入 JSON 以避免浪费额度
skills.description_en: Screen post-earnings gap-up stocks for PEAD (Post-Earnings Announcement Drift) patterns. Analyzes weekly candle formation to detect red candle pullbacks and breakout signals. Supports two input modes - FMP earnings calendar (Mode A) or earnings-trade-analyzer JSON output (Mode B). Use when user asks about PEAD screening, post-earnings drift, earnings gap follow-through, red candle breakout patterns, or weekly earnings momentum setups.

skills.name: stockbee-exhaustion-hammer-screener
skills.description_zh: 筛选卖出衰竭锤子形态的短线机会。
skills.func: 按Stockbee法扫描抛售衰竭锤子线反转候选并评分
skills.how: 帮我找强势股回调后出现长下影锤子线、可能见底反弹的标的
skills.input: FMP 数据源账号，或股票代码列表 / 日线 OHLCV 的 JSON（临收盘场景可用当日临时K线，可选附质量元数据）
skills.output: JSON 与 Markdown 报告，含触发类型、距近期高点的回调幅度与天数、跌破/收回状态、锤子线几何（下影/实体/收盘位置/自低点回收）、量比与平均成交额、入场与止损参考、评分、评级、状态与淘汰原因
skills.note: 提供 OHLCV JSON 时可离线运行；输出为候选生成，非自动下单
skills.description_en: Screen US stocks for Stockbee-style selling-exhaustion hammer setups using prior momentum, pullback depth, undercut/reclaim, long lower-wick geometry, close-location, volume confirmation, quality/liquidity gates, and risk-distance scoring. Use when the user asks for Stockbee, Pradeep Bonde, exhaustion setup, selling exhaustion, hammer reversal, undercut reclaim, near-close reversal candidates, or pullback entries in high-quality funds-owned stocks.

skills.name: stockbee-momentum-burst-screener
skills.description_zh: 筛选突破、区间扩张与成交量放大驱动的动量爆发形态。
skills.func: 按Stockbee动量爆发法扫描美股短期突破候选并评分分级
skills.how: 帮我找最近出现4%放量突破、可能走短线行情的股票
skills.input: FMP 数据源账号，或直接给股票代码列表 / 含日线 OHLCV 的 JSON 文件
skills.output: JSON 与 Markdown 报告，含触发类型（4%突破/美元突破/区间扩张）、当日涨幅、量比、收盘位置、前期整理宽度、入场与止损参考、风险百分比，以及评分、评级、状态与淘汰原因
skills.note: 提供 OHLCV JSON 时可完全离线运行；结果仅作候选生成，非自动下单
skills.description_en: Screen US stocks for Stockbee-style short-term Momentum Burst setups using 4% breakout, dollar breakout, range expansion, volume expansion, prior range contraction, close-location, failure filters, and risk-distance scoring. Use when the user asks for Stockbee, Pradeep Bonde, momentum burst, 4% breakout, range expansion, dollar breakout, short-term swing momentum candidates, or 3-5 day burst setup review.

skills.name: us-undervalued-growth-screener
skills.description_zh: 筛选兼具估值优势与成长性的美股机会。
skills.func: 端到端筛选并排名美股低估成长/GARP标的，附审计包
skills.how: 帮我筛一批被低估、未来两三年有较大上涨空间的成长股
skills.input: FMP 数据源账号（必需）；可仅给一句话需求（默认范围：NYSE/Nasdaq/NYSE American，市值 5 亿-200 亿美元）
skills.output: reports/ 下生成 JSON 与 Markdown 报告及自包含审计 ZIP，含正式排名与评分明细、2 年/3 年固定倍数与 20% 估值收缩情景、入选标的的财报与预测桥、GAAP 对账、同业与周期风险、失效条件
skills.note: 为多脚本流水线，含分阶段采集、严格评估与发布前审计，需逐个脚本执行
skills.description_en: Autonomously screen NYSE, Nasdaq, and NYSE American operating-company stocks for undervalued-growth/GARP opportunities using forward same-basis valuation, driver-derived EPS/FCF forecasts, primary-source financial verification, SBC and dilution controls, sector and cycle normalization, auditable candidate-pool coverage, and fail-closed final reporting. Use when asked to find, screen, rank, or refresh US undervalued-growth stocks, including minimal requests with no ticker list or parameters.

skills.name: value-dividend-screener
skills.description_zh: 筛选同时具备估值优势与较高股息率的个股。
skills.func: 筛选低估值、高股息且持续增长的美股并综合评分排名
skills.how: 帮我筛一批估值合理、股息持续增长的高质量分红股
skills.input: FMP 数据源账号（必需）；可选 FINVIZ Elite 数据源账号 做两级预筛、top N、输出路径
skills.output: JSON 结果文件与 Markdown 报告，含股息率、市盈率、市净率、3 年股息/营收/EPS 复合增速、派息率与自由现金流覆盖、财务健康与质量评分，并按综合分排名及给出组合构建建议
skills.note: 两级模式用 FINVIZ 预筛可把 FMP 调用量降低约 90%
skills.description_en: Screen US stocks for high-quality dividend opportunities combining value characteristics (P/E ratio under 20, P/B ratio under 2), attractive yields (3% or higher), and consistent growth (dividend/revenue/EPS trending up over 3 years). Supports two-stage screening using FINVIZ Elite API for efficient pre-filtering followed by FMP API for detailed analysis. Use when user requests dividend stock screening, income portfolio ideas, or quality value stocks with strong fundamentals.

skills.name: vcp-screener
skills.description_zh: 筛选波动收缩形态，识别处于上升阶段的个股。
skills.func: 扫描标普500识别波动收缩形态，或回溯单只股票的历史VCP
skills.how: 帮我筛处于第二阶段上涨、波动不断收缩、接近突破点的股票
skills.input: FMP 数据源账号（必需）；可指定自定义股票池，或指定单只股票做历史形态回溯及各类检测阈值
skills.output: JSON 与 Markdown 报告，含复合评分与评级、执行状态（Pre-breakout/Breakout 等）、形态类型、T1/T2/T3 收缩深度、枢轴价与止损、量能与相对强度；历史模式输出按时间排列的检测时间线与前瞻结果统计
skills.note: 历史单股模式仅需两次接口调用，定位为形态研究而非组合仓位参考
skills.description_en: Screen S&P 500 stocks for Mark Minervini's Volatility Contraction Pattern (VCP) and detect historical VCPs in a single ticker's price path. Identifies Stage 2 uptrend stocks forming tight bases with contracting volatility near breakout pivot points; in historical single-ticker mode walks a multi-year history and emits every VCP that formed with forward-outcome stats (breakout / stop-hit / timeout). Use when user requests VCP screening, Minervini-style setups, tight base patterns, volatility contraction breakout candidates, Stage 2 momentum stock scanning, or historical VCP pattern study on a specific ticker (e.g. FIX, TSLA).

skills.name: scanner-bullish
skills.description_zh: 用均线、相对强弱与 MACD 等指标扫描看涨趋势个股。
skills.func: 用技术指标扫描股票并按看涨综合分排序
skills.how: 帮我看看手头这几只股票现在哪只趋势最强
skills.input: 逗号分隔的股票代码；可选返回条数（--top）与分析周期（1mo/3mo/6mo）
skills.output: JSON 输出，按综合分从高到低排列，含每只股的价格、评分、RSI、MACD 及金叉死叉状态、ADX 与方向指标、EMA9/21 交叉、期间涨跌幅、距均线百分比及命中信号列表，另含下次财报时间
skills.note: 依赖 pandas/pandas-ta/yfinance，行情由 yfinance 拉取；需按纽约时区输出
skills.description_en: Scan stocks for bullish trends using technical indicators (SMA, RSI, MACD, ADX). Use when user asks to scan for bullish stocks, find trending stocks, or rank symbols by momentum.

skills.name: scanner-pmcc
skills.description_zh: 筛选适合长期期权备兑策略的个股，评估流动性与收益。
skills.func: 扫描期权链评估Poor Man's Covered Call适配度并打分
skills.how: 帮我看看哪些股票适合做长期备兑开仓（买长期看涨+卖短期看涨）
skills.input: 逗号分隔的股票代码，或看涨扫描器输出的 JSON 文件；可选最小 LEAPS 到期天数、LEAPS 与短期 call 的目标 delta
skills.output: JSON 结果（按分数排序，含 LEAPS 与短期 call 的到期、行权价、delta、由买卖价算出的 IV、点差、成交量/持仓量、年化收益率、下次财报日与逐项评分明细），并可据此生成 Markdown 报告
skills.note: 依赖 numpy/pandas/scipy/yfinance 拉取期权链；盘外时段点差被强制为 100%，分数不可与盘中相比
skills.description_en: Scan stocks for Poor Man's Covered Call (PMCC) suitability. Analyzes LEAPS and short call options for delta, liquidity, spread, IV, yield, trend direction, and earnings proximity. Use when user asks about PMCC candidates, diagonal spreads, or LEAPS strategies.

skills.name: trade-compare
skills.description_zh: 把两只标的在估值、成长、盈利、技术面、情绪与风险上做正面对比。
skills.func: 对两只股票按七大类指标逐项打分对比，给出总体推荐
skills.how: 帮我对比一下两只股票，看哪只更值得买
skills.input: 两个股票代码（触发命令 /trade compare 代码1 代码2 或 代码1 vs 代码2）
skills.output: 生成 TRADE-COMPARE-<代码1>-vs-<代码2>.md 文件，含速判结论、公司概况、估值/成长/盈利/财务健康/技术/情绪/风险七张对比表、加权记分卡、不同投资者类型推荐及「底线」总结
skills.note: 通过联网搜索采集两只股票的公开数据，非本地脚本计算
skills.description_en: Head-to-Head Stock Comparison — takes two tickers and compares them across valuation, growth, profitability, technical setup, sentiment, risk profile, and analyst consensus with a scored comparison table and overall recommendation.
